name: ethantiv-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Mirosław Zaniewicz.

plugins.name: babysit-pr
plugins.description: Local equivalent of autofix-pr: monitor and fix the current PR (CI failures, review comments, merge conflicts) in the local Claude Code session, then merge it and delete its branch once a pass is clean

plugins.name: docstyle
plugins.description: Apply the Google developer documentation style guide when creating, editing, or auditing technical documentation. Edits files in place; --audit reports findings without edits. Ships the full guide (70 pages) as local references with a topic index. In Claude Code a SessionStart hook also applies the core rules, plus Polish style rules for Polish, to chat replies; /docstyle:docstyle on|off toggles it (default on).

plugins.name: eli
plugins.description: Explain like I'm an intern: explain any concept, term, or piece of code to a smart adult who simply lacks domain knowledge — short, vivid, example-driven, no fluff.

plugins.name: read-arxiv-paper
plugins.description: Download arXiv paper LaTeX source, analyze it, and produce a project-contextualized summary

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Edit LLM-generated documents to remove telltale signs of AI writing (per Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing"): AI vocabulary, negative parallelisms, rule of three, promotional tone, vague attributions, throat-clearing, fake-profound kickers, formatting slop — plus Polish officialese and bureaucratic heaviness. Polish and English. Audit mode reports findings with severity instead of editing.

plugins.name: visual-prompt
plugins.description: Generate three .txt files with artistic text-to-image prompts in three contrasting visual directions, written by separate subagents in parallel in the conversation language. Two profiles: art (artwork, posters, photography) and ui (artistic interface mockups). Slash-invocable skills: /visual-prompt-art, /visual-prompt-ui.

plugins.name: refine
plugins.description: Rewrite a chaotic, stream-of-consciousness prompt into a clear, structured one that keeps every real requirement, then ask whether to accept it (the agent starts working on it), revise it with your notes, copy it to the clipboard, or reject it.
